text: No ankle swelling makes heart failure less likely, and the wheezing combined with your exertional dyspnea points toward a respiratory cause. Have you noticed any recent weight loss, night sweats, or a history of smoking? DIAGNOSIS READY: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease (COPD)
